display_name: Liberty HomeCare home insurance rules (Quy tắc bảo hiểm nhà cửa, UW-RPP-W-001-06-V): material damage, personal and family liability, additional benefits, general exclusions and general conditions

run.method: one agent, one session (resumed once after a usage-limit pause), no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Vietnamese is quoted only in `-- src:N |` comments generated by tools/vnsrc.py quote from line N of the raw text, and in short runs that tools/vnsrc.py check finds verbatim in it. GLOSSARY.md is the bilingual key.

documents.authority: private contract terms published by the insurer on its own website; not law

aids.what: Law on Insurance Business 08/2022/QH15, read to record LAW forks; not encoded

scope: The whole document: the Introduction (when cover attaches), every Definition, the nine Insured Perils with their exclusions, Part 1 (cover, basis of settlement, Provisions 1-3, Pairs and Sets, General Limit, proof of value, Extensions 1-7, Exclusions 1-8), Part 2 (cover, costs, limits, jurisdiction, additional definitions, waiver of subrogation, tenant's liability extension, Exclusions 1-17, Conditions 1-3), Part 3 (temporary accommodation and rent, death benefit, domestic helper's effects), General Exclusions 1-9 and General Conditions 1-14 with the short-period scale. Everything left to the Policy Summary is an input with no default. Inert: descriptive and procedural text (12 rows). Out of scope: Part 2 cross liability (src:498-500), because the case model cannot express a claim between co-insureds. See NOTES.md sections 1-2.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this encoding against the source. No independent test pass has been run. Every expected value in the tests was written by the same session that wrote the rules (worked by hand from the text before being asserted; the figures module parses its expected values from the raw text by script).

self_check.vnsrc_check: vnsrc check: 1025 src: lines, 473 Vietnamese runs, 0 problems

forks.F-attach: Introduction: either limb attaches cover (Certificate or Summary agreed; or proposal accepted and premium paid in time).
forks.F-period: Period of Insurance: dates, both edges inside; no hour modelled.
forks.F-family: 'Regularly living with the Insured' governs spouse and children too.
forks.F-home-c: Home exclusion (c) names lodging establishments, strata-title apartments and mobile homes, not every house and apartment.
forks.F-contents-j: Contents exclusion (j) reaches portable equipment; non-portable photographic and sports equipment stays Contents.
forks.F-total-si: Total Part 1 sum insured is the sum of the item sums insured stated; 0 if none.
forks.F-ext-base: Extensions 4 and 6: 10% of the total Part 1 sum insured.
forks.F-ext-within: Extension costs sit inside the General Limit.
forks.F-order: Part 1: Provisions, GC6, Pairs and Sets, General Limit, GC9, then the Deductible last.
forks.F-pairs: Pairs and Sets: proportion is parts lost over parts in the set.
forks.F-72h: Extension 7: closed 72-hour periods placed from the earliest uncovered loss.
forks.F-flood: Peril 5(g) and (h) do not reach water that is the flood as defined.
forks.F-theft-c: Peril 9(c): theft from a let part only.
forks.F-ge1: General Exclusion 1: (a)-(c) and their suppression are each excluded, though the chapeau names terrorism.
forks.F-gc1: GC1: every duty is a condition precedent (LAW art 46, art 19(3) noted).
forks.F-gc2: GC2: voidable at the Insurer's election (LAW art 22(2) noted).
forks.F-gc4g: GC4(g): day 0 is the event; delivery on day 30 is in time (LAW art 30 noted).
forks.F-gc7b: GC7(b): 12 calendar months by add months; the last day is in time.
forks.F-gc10: GC10: arbitration is optional for either party.
forks.F-gc11-notice: GC11: the Insurer's 30 days run from sending.
forks.F-gc11-pro-rata: GC11: pro rata by days in force over days in the Period.
forks.F-short-period: Short-period scale: the first printed row that fits wins (exactly 3 months 30%, exactly 6 months 60%).
forks.F-gc11-refund: GC11: the Insured's refund is never negative.
forks.F-deductible: A Part with no Deductible in the Summary has none.
forks.F-p2-relative: Part 2 limb (b): any relative of the Insured, resident or not.
forks.F-jurisdiction: Part 2 jurisdiction: the first-instance qualifier attaches to judgments; settlements are not reached.
forks.F-excl3: Part 2 exclusion 3: 'has used the Home' means as a place to live; 60 days or more; more than 90 strict.
forks.F-tenant: Tenant's extension: liability under the tenancy agreement sent to the Insurer escapes exclusion 2 too.
forks.F-p2-costs: Part 2 costs are on top of the limit, cut by the proviso.
forks.F-p2-limit: Part 2 proviso ratio uses the limit that binds the claim.
forks.F-p3-trigger: Part 3 accommodation: the Peril test and General Exclusions; the Home need not be insured.
forks.F-p3-shared: Part 3: one 10% limit shared by rent and accommodation.
forks.F-p3-months: Part 3: months insured is 6; fractions allowed.
forks.F-p3-rent: Part 3 rent limb: the residence requirements of the Insured Location and Home are not applied.
forks.F-death-amount: Death benefit: the limit is paid as a fixed sum.
forks.F-age: Death benefit: age in completed years on the day of injury, 5 and 65 included.
forks.F-3-months: Death within 3 calendar months of the injury, by add months.
forks.F-theft-death: Death benefit: theft in its ordinary sense.
forks.F-helper-2: Helper proviso 2 applied as written (inert for a helper's own effects).
forks.LAW-48: No average clause; Law art 48 noted, not supplied.
forks.LAW-31: No payment deadline; Law art 31(1) 15 days noted, not supplied.
forks.LAW-26: Cancellation without cause; Law art 26 noted.
forks.LAW-54: Subrogation against family; Law art 54(3) noted.
